name: command-code-provider
description: Use Command Code models in VS Code's AI features, including Copilot Chat.

cmdcode.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `command-code` CLI. Leave empty to resolve `cmd` on `PATH` automatically.

cmdcode.maxTurns.description: Maximum agent turns per request, passed as --max-turns. Clamped to 1-100.

cmdcode.timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock deadline for a single request, in seconds. 0 disables the deadline.

cmdcode.maxPromptChars.description: Maximum characters in the rendered prompt. History is truncated to fit; the live request never is.

cmdcode.imageSupport.markdownDescription: Read images you attach, on vision-capable models. On the CLI path this tells the Command Code CLI to read images without asking each time, because a headless run has no way to prompt. Turn it off to never send images.

cmdcode.enableCliProvider.markdownDescription: Offer the **Command Code CLI** provider group. Works on every plan, reads images, but cannot run Copilot's tools. Turn it off to run API-only.

cmdcode.enableApiProvider.markdownDescription: Offer the **Command Code API** provider group. Needs an API key and a GOAT-or-higher plan. This is the only path that can run Copilot's tools, including browser control.

cmdcode.zeroDataRetention.markdownDescription: API only. Enforce zero data retention (`x-cmd-zdr: 1`): no prompt training, and requests are refused rather than routed through a provider that cannot honour it. Narrows which tools may be sent, so some tools are dropped when this is on.

cmdcode.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the "Cmd Code" output channel.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && vitest run
